description: This file defines the EventHandler interface for handling web events within the OFBiz framework. It declares methods for initializing the handler and invoking events, including references to specific OFBiz classes related to configuration and servlet handling.

classes.name: EventHandler
classes.description: Interface for handling web events, providing initialization and invocation methods.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the event handler with the provided ServletContext; used for setup and configurations.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Executes the web event based on provided event details, request map, and HTTP request/response objects, returning a result code.
